properties.site-address: Site of the former Foulstone School
properties.notes: The former Foulstone School. This brownfield site is part of a wider site (H41) proposed for housing in the Local Plan Publication Draft 2016. The proposed policy also requires any development to investigate options for either a small scale convenience shop that is in compliance with Local Plan Policy TC5 Local Shops or an extension to Darfield Local Centre that is in compliance with local and national policy to protect town centres.
properties.name: H41
